label: Late original-phase inputs and the <DEL> step (t >= 5, before copying starts)
explanation: Positional envelope feature. It never fires at t <= 2, rarely at t = 3, and essentially never in the copy phase after the first output (0.05% of copy steps). Activity is confined to original-phase steps from about t = 4 onward plus the <DEL> step: the <DEL> step fires 36% of the time and carries 35% of the mass, and orig_idx 5-7 fire 33-41% of the time. Within that window it is sparse and depends on sequence content in a diffuse way. First tokens x/c/d/t/e, earlier q/d tokens, and first occurrences of a token (in_first) all raise the rate a bit, but no token set picks out the active steps (token-conditioned predicates scored F1 <= 0.42). Top activations come at late original steps and <DEL> in sequences of length 5-7 that start with x/t/e/q. The envelope (phase <= 1) & (t >= 4) covers 99.6% of mass at 30% precision; the t >= 5 version trades recall for F1 of about 0.51.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: 3, p, g, o, 2, t; least: f, -, 0, q) and the second original token (most: d, q, 0, c, y, e; least: k, p, z, j); timing cues that raise it most: t=6, t=5, t=7.
